title: Virtual Assistant for Contractors: VA vs AI on the Phones
summary: Virtual assistant for contractors: the tasks a VA handles well, the phone coverage one person can't give, and how an AI receptionist covers calls 24/7.
body_markdown:
A virtual assistant for contractors is a remote assistant who handles admin such as scheduling, estimate follow-up, invoicing and CRM updates. Phones are the hardest part to cover: one person works set hours, takes one call at a time and needs days off. Many contractors put an[AI receptionist](https://sameday.ai/features/ai-csrs) on the phones 24/7 and give the VA the back-office work.


Sibling guides from the same week:[Thumbtack vs Angi](https://sameday.ai/post/thumbtack-vs-angi) ,[Google Business Profile for contractors](https://sameday.ai/post/google-business-profile-for-contractors) , and[restoration software](https://sameday.ai/post/restoration-software) .


## What a virtual assistant does for a contracting business


Contractors who hire a virtual assistant usually start with work that does not require a truck roll. The list below is common across trades; your VA may do a subset depending on experience and the access you give.


- Inbox and calendar management
- Estimate follow-up and appointment reminders
- Invoicing and collections reminders
- Permit and inspection paperwork
- CRM cleanup and data entry
- Review requests after completed jobs
- Supplier orders and material tracking
- Light social posting or content scheduling


Some VAs also answer phones during business hours. That works until volume spikes, someone is sick, or a call arrives while the VA is on another line. For a dedicated[AI receptionist](https://sameday.ai/features/ai-csrs) on inbound calls, see the comparison below.


## Trade-specific VA tasks


### Roofing virtual assistant


Roofing shops often hand a VA storm-season lead follow-up, inspection scheduling, insurance paperwork and CRM updates. When hail hits a metro, inspection requests can stack faster than one person can dial back. The trade page is[roofing](https://sameday.ai/industries/roofing) .


### HVAC virtual assistant


HVAC VAs commonly run maintenance-agreement reminders, seasonal tune-up scheduling, estimate follow-up and schedule updates in ServiceTitan or Housecall Pro when you grant access. Phone coverage on the first hot weekend or a cold snap is harder to staff with one remote person. See[HVAC](https://sameday.ai/industries/hvac) for how the phones tie into booking.


### Plumbing virtual assistant


Plumbing VAs often chase open estimates, coordinate permit and inspection appointments and keep customer records current. Urgent calls still need someone on the line when the VA is at lunch or offline. The trade page is[plumbing](https://sameday.ai/industries/plumbing-industry) .


## The phone problem: coverage one person can't give


Hiring a virtual assistant does not remove the physics of phone work. One remote person:


- Works the hours you agree on, in a time zone you choose
- Takes one live call at a time
- Needs breaks, sick days and holidays
- Cannot cover nights, weekends and storms unless you schedule shifts
- Must learn your price book, service area and job types over time
- Needs updates when you change fees, crews or dispatch rules


Back-office work can run on a set schedule. Inbound calls rarely do.


That gap is why many contractors split the work: an AI receptionist covers[nights, weekends and holidays](https://sameday.ai/playbooks/after-hours-answering) , and the VA handles follow-ups, invoices and CRM cleanup the next morning.

## Splitting the work: AI on the phones, VA on the back office


Who handles what


1.


List every inbound call type for one week


New lead, existing customer, emergency, vendor, wrong number. Tag what actually books revenue.


2.


Mark the ones that book a job


Those are the calls that need live coverage first, not a callback tomorrow.


3.


Set the ring timeout


Ring the office first; use a[ring timeout](https://sameday.ai/playbooks/missed-call-text-back) so calls your team can't pick up go to the AI instead of voicemail.


4.


Give the VA the follow-ups, invoices and CRM tasks


Morning blocks for estimate chase, permit filing and data cleanup work well after overnight calls are logged.


5.


Review call summaries weekly together


Compare what the AI booked with what the VA followed up. Adjust scripts and handoff rules from real calls.


Field crews can't pause for every ring. Coverage on the phones is the part to automate first.


## Questions to ask before you hire a VA


- What hours and time zone will you cover?
- Who answers when you are sick or on vacation?
- Will you log into ServiceTitan or Housecall Pro, and at what permission level?
- Do you have experience in our trade?
- How are live calls handed off to the owner or dispatcher?
- How do you handle customer data and confidentiality?


Neutral answers are fine. The goal is to know where the VA stops and where phone coverage still needs a backup.

## FAQ


### What does a virtual assistant do for contractors?


A contractor's virtual assistant is a remote assistant who usually handles admin work: scheduling, estimate follow-up, invoicing reminders, permit paperwork, CRM updates and review requests. Some also answer phones during set hours.


### What does a roofing virtual assistant do?


Common roofing VA tasks include following up on inspection and estimate requests, scheduling inspections, keeping the CRM current and handling insurance paperwork. During storm season, call volume often outgrows what one person can answer at once.


### What does an HVAC virtual assistant do?


HVAC VAs commonly schedule maintenance visits, send tune-up reminders before each season, follow up on estimates and update ServiceTitan or Housecall Pro when you grant access. Phone coverage at night and during heat waves is the hardest part to staff.


### Is an AI receptionist the same as a virtual assistant?


No. A virtual assistant is a person working remotely on tasks you assign. An AI receptionist answers calls and texts 24/7, can answer multiple calls at once, qualifies the caller and books the job into your software during the call.


### Can a VA and an AI receptionist work together?


Yes. A common split is to let the AI receptionist answer calls your team can't pick up, around the clock, and to give the VA back-office work like follow-ups, invoices and CRM cleanup.


### Can an AI receptionist book jobs into ServiceTitan or Housecall Pro?


Sameday books jobs into ServiceTitan (Certified ServiceTitan app) and Housecall Pro during the call, matching existing customers or creating new records.


### Do virtual assistants speak Spanish?


Spanish coverage varies by hire. Sameday includes Spanish on every plan; other languages are Enterprise-only.
